{"title":"Case Study 1: VoltNova Dynamic Limited","subtitle":"Invoice operations transformed in 4 weeks","columns":"1","features":[{"idx":1,"title":"Implementation Summary","content":"Challenge:

500+ monthly invoices, manual formatting, delayed reconciliation, and two-week month-end close.

What we built:

ERPNext Sales + Inventory + Accounting configuration, branded print formats, payment matching automation, and live dashboards.

Results:

Invoice processing: 4 hrs/day to 15 min/day (94% faster).

Invoicing errors: 15-20/month to 0-1/month (95% reduction).

Payment reconciliation: 2 hrs/day to 5 min/day (96% faster).

Month-end close: 2 weeks to 2 days.

ROI: Investment Ksh 120,000 with payback in roughly 2.9 months."}]}

page_blocks.name: d45qdv93a9
page_blocks.web_template_values:
{"title":"Case Study 2: Finerate Ventures Limited","subtitle":"Approval workflow and AP reconciliation at scale","columns":"1","features":[{"idx":1,"title":"Implementation Summary","content":"Challenge:

50+ suppliers, email-based approvals, late fees, weak audit trail, and duplicated vendor payments.

What we built:

ERPNext accounting setup, 3-level custom approval workflow, escalation alerts, duplicate-payment prevention, and n8n automation for AP events.

Results:

Payment processing: 3 hrs/day to 30 min/day (83% faster).

Approval cycle: 1-2 weeks to 1-2 days (75% faster).

Late fees: approximately Ksh 10k-15k/month to near zero.

Finance admin: saved around 10 hrs/week.

ROI: Ksh 150,000 implementation with approximately 5.7-month payback."}]}

{"title":"Case Study 3: Tookio Shop Sellers","subtitle":"Multi-channel inventory and payment visibility for social commerce","columns":"1","features":[{"idx":1,"title":"Implementation Summary","content":"Challenge:

Sellers were overselling across Instagram and WhatsApp, processing refunds frequently, and running profitability blindly.

What we built:

Multi-tenant Frappe setup with synchronized inventory, unified order dashboard, M-Pesa matching, and analytics for pricing and reorders.

Results:

Overselling incidents: 3-4/week to 0-1/month (95% reduction).

Inventory admin time: 2 hrs/day to 15 min/day (87% faster).

Order fulfillment: 1-2 days to 4-6 hours (70% faster).

Monthly revenue for top sellers: Ksh 150k-200k to Ksh 300k-400k."}]}
